row.scim_price_text: ~US$200 SRP per eligible subscription (min. 50 subscriptions); Contact Sales
row.scim_addon_price_text: Business Success Plan: approximately US $200 SRP per eligible offering; one BSP subscription per eligible product subscription
row.evidence: Autodesk's plans page lists Directory sync only under the Business Success Plan (Contact us), and the SSO help article says 'Customers with the Business Success Plan gain the additional benefit of using Autodesk's directory sync capability with SSO'.
row.notes: Unchanged status (gated). SAML SSO is now an included benefit of every product subscription; SCIM directory sync (Okta SCIM, Azure AD/Entra SCIM, or an on-premises AD agent) needs the Business Success Plan add-on. New since June: the plans FAQ prices the BSP upgrade at 'approximately US $200 SRP for eligible Offerings', requires at least 50 eligible product subscriptions and one BSP subscription per product subscription, and sells it only in the US, UK, EU, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Japan. The billing period of the $200 is not stated, so no per-user figure is derived. June's '~$500-$3,375/yr' product price range and 'Premium upgrade ~$300/yr/seat' had no first-party source in this pass and are dropped. Autodesk Learn still calls it the 'Premium plan team'. SCIM endpoint and token are shown only in the admin console; no generic SCIM docs are published by Autodesk.

operations.notes: Microsoft's tutorial says 'Remove users'; JumpCloud says provision, update and deprovision. Whether removal deactivates or deletes the Autodesk user is not documented by Autodesk.

filtering.notes: From the Microsoft Entra tutorial's 'Supported for filtering' column.

roles.how: Groups drive product (entitlement) assignment rather than roles

limitations.text: SSO must be enabled before directory sync can be set up.
Synced users and groups are read-only in Autodesk Account.
Business Success Plan requires at least 50 eligible subscriptions and is sold only in the US, UK, EU, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Japan.
The only admin APIs on the plans page are usage Reporting APIs, which are Business Success Plan only and cover usage and subscription data, not user management.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked (read from page markup).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud uses the Okta SCIM option in Autodesk's directory sync setup.
